body:
## Code Review

Multi-agent review of PR #220 (notifications + tabs refactor): `code-reviewer`, `type-design-analyzer`, `silent-failure-hunter`. Tabs refactor is a clear win. Notifications feature has shippable bones but two user-visible silent failures block merge.

### Findings
- 🔴 **1 Critical** — must fix before merge
- 🟠 **1 Important** — should fix
- 🔵 **1 Suggestion** — nice-to-have

### Strengths
- Tabs refactor unifies 5 ad-hoc implementations.
- DOMPurify correctly applied at render boundary.

### Recommendation
Fix the 1 Critical item, then ship. Estimated: 30 minutes.

comments.body:
![critical](https://img.shields.io/badge/Priority-Critical-red)

`handleAccept` only `console.log`s then fires `toast.success(...)` — no API call. Friend request reappears on refresh while user sees a lying success toast.

Fix: wire to `useAcceptFriendRequest` from `features/friends/api/`, OR remove the button until the endpoint exists. No inline suggestion because the fix imports a hook from another file.

![important](https://img.shields.io/badge/Priority-Important-orange)

The documentation comment states that `isNetworkLoggingEnabled` defaults to `true`, but the implementation on line 43 initializes it to `false`. Based on the PR description and `docs/logging.md`, `false` is the intended default. Update the comment to match the implementation.

```suggestion
  /// Defaults to `false`. Flip from anywhere at runtime:
```
